projects.title: Agent Reliability Harness
projects.problem: An agent can return a perfect-looking final answer while double-issuing refunds, skipping checks, or leaking secrets along the way.
projects.built: A trajectory-regression harness on PyPI: policy-as-code trajectory rules, baseline-vs-candidate CI gates, OpenAI/Anthropic transcript adapters, JUnit/SARIF reports.
projects.decision: Zero runtime dependencies and byte-deterministic reports, so the evaluator itself can never flake a CI pipeline.
projects.result: v0.2.1 on PyPI; 194 tests across 3 OSes and Python 3.11-3.13; benchmark precision/recall 1.0 on 34 seeded failures; a live demo PR blocked by the gate.
projects.learned: Deterministic policy checks beat model-judged evals in CI: cheaper, explainable, and reproducible.

projects.title: MSW Inspector
projects.problem: Mock handlers drift from real API calls, hiding coverage gaps.
projects.built: A TypeScript CLI and GitHub Action that compares AST-parsed handlers and calls.
projects.decision: ts-morph over text matching to understand fetch, Axios, and handler code.
projects.result: A public package and Marketplace action with contributors, cross-platform CI, releases, and a roadmap.
projects.learned: Maintaining a public tool means docs, releases, and contributor experience matter as much as the parser.

projects.title: TypeJung
projects.problem: An assessment needs reliable account, payment, persistence, and recovery paths to become a product.
projects.built: Assessment UX, auth, persisted results, Stripe payments, email capture, and AI reports.
projects.decision: Bound model output inside a deterministic workflow; keep billing and account state outside it.
projects.result: 22 registered and 7 paying users as of July 13, 2026; CA$74 recorded June 29.
projects.learned: Real payments shift the work: recovery paths, webhook idempotency, and account-state edge cases dominate after launch.
